description: With several connected accounts, connectionId (from get_social_accounts) names the one the user chose. Schedules one video for external publication at postAt, from exactly one source: a Clypmint video (videoId, outputId, expectedEditId), an upload (mediaId) or a public link (mediaUrl). Requires the caption, platforms, IANA timezone and platform-specific choices. Instagram trial reel: platformOptions.INSTAGRAM {trial: true}. Returns a publishing receipt; pending acknowledgement is distinct from a confirmed schedule. Repeating operationId with identical arguments returns the original receipt.

connectionId.description: Which connected account, from get_social_accounts; needed when there are several.

expectedEditId.description: The version_id check_video showed the user, so a newer edit is never posted by mistake.

mediaId.description: A file the user uploaded: media_id from upload_for_post. Instead of videoId.

mediaUrl.description: A public https link to the video file itself. Instead of videoId.

outputId.description: The output to post (a hook, Short or shape), from check_video.

platformOptions.description: TikTok and YouTube settings, needed there. INSTAGRAM {trial: true, graduation: "auto"} posts a trial reel (non-followers first); graduation "manual" when the user will share it.

platforms.description: Where to post: INSTAGRAM, TIKTOK and/or YOUTUBE.

postAt.description: When to post: an ISO time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-14T17:00:00-05:00.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone the user means, e.g. America/Chicago.

videoId.description: The video to post, from list_videos.

name: schedule_post

outputSchema.description: Clypmint schedule_post result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Schedule a video
